invariants.rationale: Option values in Java are typically non-null; the method always returns an Option, possibly empty.
restoreInstantTimestamp is required to schedule a restore action, so it's expected to be non-null.
A savepoint timestamp must be specified for the restore operation, thus is expected to be non-null.
context is necessary for actions on the engine and must not be null.
The returned type is Option<HoodieRestorePlan>, so result is guaranteed to be an Option type.
